summary: E2E UI validation on preview (mobile 390x844) of (1) structured establishment address fields, (2) merchant address display + Google Maps link on deliverer cards, and (3) the 4-digit code E2E delivery-completion flow. All primary assertions PASSED. Merchant registers, adds establishment via add-est-btn, fills structured address (est-street/est-number/est-neighborhood/est-city/est-complement), enables offers-delivery, sets discount 10%, saves via est-save; reload confirms every field persisted individually. Merchant creates 'Nova entrega OFF360' (m-new-order-btn → mode delivery + scope external → m-new-create) with consumer QAADR e-mail. Deliverer sees the offer with d-address block showing 'Rua: Rua das Flores · Nº 123', 'Bairro: Jardim do Lago', 'Cidade: Campinas', 'Complemento: Bloco 2, Casa dos fundos, Apto 14' and d-maps-link href starts with https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=... containing the address. d-address remains visible after ACEITAR (Em andamento tab). Deliverer starts (d-start-dialog with amount/earning) → 'CHEGUEI COM OFF360' (d-arrive) → code input d-code-<id> appears. Consumer navigates to /order/<id> and sees the 4-digit code in order-code and status label 'Chegou com OFF360'. Deliverer typing a WRONG code shows toast error and keeps the code input visible (order NOT completed). Typing the CORRECT code completes the delivery: order moves to Histórico tab and consumer status label becomes 'Entregue'. m-deliverers-section on /merchant/orders is intact (regression PASS). Leading-zero code case not observed in this run (server-issued code was 8179); backend script validation for leading zeros was already confirmed per agent-to-agent context; the UI uses maxLength=4 + inputMode=numeric without type=number, so leading zeros ARE preserved as strings and sent as-is to /deliverer/orders/{oid}/validate-code (verified by code review of Deliverer.js d-code-<id> Input).
critical_code_review_comments: Establishment.js line 55-59: `streetVal = form.street ?? (form.address || '')` and `address: (form.number ? "${streetVal}, ${form.number}" : streetVal)` keep the legacy 'address' in sync. Good for backward-compat; consider deprecating the legacy field long-term to avoid double source-of-truth.

Deliverer.js AddressBlock: when only legacy address is present, it renders `a.legacy` as street line and still shows the 'Como chegar' link — good. Consider also showing 'Nenhum endereço cadastrado — contate o estabelecimento' when parts.length===0 && no legacy — currently returns null which is fine but silent.
Deliverer.js d-code-<id> uses inputMode=numeric maxLength=4 (no type=number) which preserves leading zeros — correct. Backend routes_delivery.py compares .strip().upper() so it is safe.
OrderTracking.js renders order-code with tracking `letter-spacing: 0.3em`; the inner_text has spaces, so any UI test must strip whitespace when comparing to what the deliverer types.

Merchant-created delivery orders skip the 'Novo/Em preparo' UI states (they land directly at status compatible with deliverer offer feed); the m-startprep/m-ready buttons don't render for these orders — that is by design (merchant Orders.js gates them by o.status). Regression checks OK: m-deliverers-section present, short order number (Pedido nº 9677) shown, status dot 'Entregue' shown.
